';
    const FANTASY_COUPON_ICON = "data:image/png;base64,";
    const LILIE_COUPON_ICON = "data:image/png;base64,";
    const ALLIANCE_FRAGMENT_ICON = "data:image/png;base64,";
    const ROCKET_FRAGMENT_ICON = "data:image/png;base64,";
    const LUXURY_COUPON_ICON = "data:image/png;base64,";
    const MYSTERIOUS_METAL_RAT_ICON = "data:image/png;base64,";
    const SPORTS_COUPON_ICON_1 = "data:image/png;base64,";
    const SPORTS_COUPON_ICON_2 = "data:image/png;base64,";
    const PIKACHU_FASHION_ICON = "data:image/png;base64,";
    const DIAMOND_ICON = "data:image/png;base64,";

    /*************************************************************************
     * 2. ESTADO DA APLICAÇÃO & PERSISTÊNCIA (LOCALSTORAGE)
     *************************************************************************/
    const STORAGE_KEY_DB = 'pokeguide_db_data_v2_pokeland_migrated';
    const STORAGE_KEY_FAVS = 'pokeguide_db_favs_v2_pokeland_migrated';
    const STORAGE_KEY_SOURCE = 'pokeguide_db_source_v2_pokeland_migrated';

    let state = {
      db: {},
      favorites: [], // array de IDs únicos: `${tabName}::${rowIndex}`
      sourceName: 'Pokeland Database • conteúdo migrado',
      activeTab: 'Tempo',
      viewMode: 'cards', // 'cards' | 'table'
      globalSearch: '',
      localSearch: '',
      filterCol: '__ALL__',
      filterVal: '__ALL__',
      sortCol: null,
      sortAsc: true,
      sidebarFilter: ''
    };

    function loadStateFromStorage() {
      try {
        const savedDb = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_DB);
        const savedFavs = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_FAVS);
        const savedSource = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_SOURCE);

        if (savedDb) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(savedDb);
          if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && Object.keys(parsed).length > 0) {
            state.db = parsed;
          } else {
            state.db = structuredClone(DEFAULT_DATABASE);
          }
        } else {
          state.db = structuredClone(DEFAULT_DATABASE);
        }

        if (savedFavs) {
          state.favorites = JSON.parse(savedFavs) || [];
        }

        if (savedSource) {
          state.sourceName = savedSource;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Erro ao carregar localStorage:', err);
        state.db = structuredClone(DEFAULT_DATABASE);
      }
    }

    function saveDatabaseToStorage() {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_DB, JSON.stringify(state.db));
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_SOURCE, state.sourceName);
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Aviso: não foi possível salvar no armazenamento local.', 'amber');
      }
    }

    function saveFavoritesToStorage() {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_FAVS, JSON.stringify(state.favorites));
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
      }
    }

    /*************************************************************************
     * 3. MOTOR DE IMPORTAÇÃO REAL DE EXCEL (.XLSX / .XLS / .CSV) VIA SHEETJS
     *************************************************************************/
    const IGNORED_SHEETS = new Set(['imagens', 'início', 'inicio', 'planilha29', 'sheet29']);
    const RENAME_SHEETS_MAP = {
      'planilha24': 'Genético',
      'planilha25': 'Pokédex & Bônus',
      'planilha26': 'Combos & Ligações',
      'planilha27': 'Camp Estável',
      'planilha28': 'Equipes Meta'
    };
    const NAV_NOISE_WORDS = new Set(['lar', 'tem', 'um', 'home', 'voltar', 'início', 'inicio']);

    function cleanCellText(val) {
      if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
      return String(val).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }

    function isNoiseToken(text) {
      if (!text) return true;
      const lower = text.toLowerCase();
      return NAV_NOISE_WORDS.has(lower);
    }

    function parseExcelWorkbook(workbook, fileName) {
      const importedDb = {};

      workbook.SheetNames.forEach((rawSheetName) => {
        const lowerName = rawSheetName.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (IGNORED_SHEETS.has(lowerName)) return;

        const finalTabName = RENAME_SHEETS_MAP[lowerName] || rawSheetName.trim();
        const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[rawSheetName];
        if (!worksheet) return;

        // Lê como matriz 2D
        const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1, defval: '' });
        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) return;

        // Limpa células de navegação ('LAR', 'TEM', 'UM') e coluna A numérica de índice de linha
        const cleanedMatrix = rows
          .map((row) => {
            const cells = row.map((c) => cleanCellText(c));
            // Remove palavras de navegação soltas
            const withoutNav = cells.map((c) => (isNoiseToken(c) ? '' : c));
            // Se a primeira célula for apenas um número de linha (ex: "1", "2", "15"), esvazia
            if (withoutNav.length > 1 && /^\d{1,4}$/.test(withoutNav[0])) {
              withoutNav[0] = '';
            }
            return withoutNav;
          })
          .filter((row) => row.some((cell) => cell !== ''));

        if (cleanedMatrix.length === 0) return;

        // Remove colunas totalmente vazias
        const maxCols = Math.max(...cleanedMatrix.map((r) => r.length));
        const activeColIndices = [];
        for (let c = 0; c < maxCols; c++) {
          if (cleanedMatrix.some((r) => r[c] && r[c] !== '')) {
            activeColIndices.push(c);
          }
        }
        if (activeColIndices.length === 0) return;

        const compactRows = cleanedMatrix.map((r) => activeColIndices.map((idx) => r[idx] || ''));

        // Define cabeçalhos a partir da primeira linha não vazia com pelo menos 2 colunas ou cria cabeçalhos genéricos
        let headerRowIdx = 0;
        if (compactRows.length > 1) {
          const firstNonEmptyCount = compactRows[0].filter(Boolean).length;
          const secondNonEmptyCount = compactRows[1].filter(Boolean).length;
          // Se a linha 0 for só um título geral de 1 célula e a linha 1 tiver várias colunas, usa linha 1 como cabeçalho
          if (firstNonEmptyCount === 1 && secondNonEmptyCount >= 2) {
            headerRowIdx = 1;
          }
        }

        const rawHeaders = compactRows[headerRowIdx];
        const headers = rawHeaders.map((h, idx) => {
          const cleanH = h.replace(/[:;]+$/, '').trim();
          return cleanH || `Coluna_${idx + 1}`;
        });

        // Garante nomes de colunas únicos
        const uniqueHeaders = [];
        const seenHeaders = {};
        headers.forEach((h) => {
          if (seenHeaders[h]) {
            seenHeaders[h] += 1;
            uniqueHeaders.push(`${h}_${seenHeaders[h]}`);
          } else {
            seenHeaders[h] = 1;
            uniqueHeaders.push(h);
          }
        });

        const dataRows = compactRows.slice(headerRowIdx + 1);
        const records = [];

        if (dataRows.length === 0) {
          // Caso a aba tenha apenas 1 linha de conteúdo
          const singleObj = {};
          uniqueHeaders.forEach((h, idx) => {
            if (rawHeaders[idx]) singleObj[h] = rawHeaders[idx];
          });
          if (Object.keys(singleObj).length > 0) records.push(singleObj);
        } else {
          dataRows.forEach((r) => {
            const obj = {};
            let hasContent = false;
            uniqueHeaders.forEach((h, idx) => {
              const val = r[idx] || '';
              if (val !== '') hasContent = true;
              obj[h] = val;
            });
            if (hasContent) records.push(obj);
          });
        }

        if (records.length > 0) {
          importedDb[finalTabName] = records;
        }
      });

      const tabNames = Object.keys(importedDb);
      if (tabNames.length === 0) {
        throw new Error('Nenhuma aba com dados válidos foi encontrada na planilha.');
      }

      state.db = importedDb;
      state.sourceName = fileName;
      state.activeTab = tabNames[0];
      state.localSearch = '';
      state.filterCol = '__ALL__';
      state.filterVal = '__ALL__';
      state.globalSearch = '';
      document.getElementById('globalSearchInput').value = '';
      document.getElementById('clearGlobalSearchBtn').classList.add('hidden');

      saveDatabaseToStorage();
      renderAll();
      const totalRecords = Object.values(importedDb).reduce((acc, arr) => acc + arr.length, 0);
      showToast(`Planilha "${fileName}" importada! ${tabNames.length} abas e ${totalRecords} registros carregados.`, 'emerald');
    }

    function handleFileUpload(file) {
      if (!file) return;
      if (typeof XLSX === 'undefined') {
        showToast('Erro: Biblioteca SheetJS não carregada. Verifique sua conexão.', 'red');
        return;
      }

      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = function (e) {
        try {
          const data = new Uint8Array(e.target.result);
          const workbook = XLSX.read(data, { type: 'array' });
          parseExcelWorkbook(workbook, file.name);
          closeImportModal();
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(err);
          showToast(`Falha ao ler planilha: ${err.message}`, 'red');
        }
      };
      reader.onerror = function () {
        showToast('Erro ao ler o arquivo selecionado.', 'red');
      };
      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
    }

    /*************************************************************************
     * 4. UTILITÁRIOS DE FAVORITOS, FORMATAÇÃO E UI
     *************************************************************************/
    function getRecordId(tabName, index) {
      return `${tabName}::${index}`;
    }

    function isFavorite(tabName, index) {
      return state.favorites.includes(getRecordId(tabName, index));
    }

    function toggleFavorite(tabName, index, event) {
      if (event) event.stopPropagation();
      const id = getRecordId(tabName, index);
      const pos = state.favorites.indexOf(id);
      if (pos >= 0) {
        state.favorites.splice(pos, 1);
        showToast('Removido dos Favoritos', 'slate');
      } else {
        state.favorites.push(id);
        showToast('Adicionado aos Favoritos ★', 'amber');
      }
      saveFavoritesToStorage();
      renderSidebar();
      renderResults();
    }

    function getCategoryForTab(tabName) {
      if (tabName === '⭐ Favoritos') return 'Acesso Rápido';
      for (const group of CATEGORY_GROUPS) {
        if (group.tabs.includes(tabName)) return group.name;
      }
      return 'Abas Importadas';
    }

    function escapeHtml(str) {
      return String(str ?? '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
    }

    // Destaca valores numéricos, bônus (+20%), diamantes, datas e estrelas
    function formatHighlightedValue(val) {
      const raw = String(val ?? '');
      const spriteMatch = raw.match(/^__SPRITE__:(\d+):(\d+)$/);
      if (spriteMatch) {
        const x = (Number(spriteMatch[1]) + 6) * (48 / 84);
        const y = (Number(spriteMatch[2]) + 6) * (48 / 84);
        return `<span class="legacy-sprite" role="img" aria-label="Imagem do registro" style="background-image:url('${GAME_SPRITE}');background-position:-${x}px -${y}px"></span>`;
      }
      const safe = escapeHtml(raw);
      if (!safe || safe === '—') return '<span class="text-slate-500">—</span>';

      // Destaque especial para HOJE
      if (/^HOJE$/i.test(safe)) {
        return `<span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40">● HOJE</span>`;
      }

      // Destaca porcentagens, sinais de +, diamantes, estrelas e números relevantes
      return safe
        .replace(/(\+\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?%?)/g, '<span class="text-emerald-400 font-semibold">$1</span>')
        .replace(/(\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{3})+(?:\s*(?:XP|EXP|diamantes|cupons|livros|libras|recursos|peças|crocos))?)/gi, '<span class="text-amber-300 font-mono font-semibold">$1</span>')
        .replace(/(⭐+)/g, '<span class="text-amber-400">$1</span>');
    }

    function showToast(message, tone = 'sky') {
      const container = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
      const colors = {
        sky: 'border-sky-500/50 bg-slate-900/95 text-sky-200',
        emerald: 'border-emerald-500/50 bg-slate-900/95 text-emerald-200',
        amber: 'border-amber-500/50 bg-slate-900/95 text-amber-200',
        red: 'border-red-500/50 bg-slate-900/95 text-red-200',
        slate: 'border-slate-600 bg-slate-900/95 text-slate-200'
      };
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.className = `pointer-events-auto px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border shadow-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-300 ${colors[tone] || colors.sky}`;
      el.textContent = message;
      container.appendChild(el);
      setTimeout(() => {
        el.style.opacity = '0';
        el.style.transform = 'translateY(8px)';
        setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 300);
      }, 3000);
    }

    /*************************************************************************
     * 5. RENDERIZAÇÃO DA SIDEBAR, PILULAS MOBILE E STATUS DO BANCO
     *************************************************************************/
    function updateHeaderStatus() {
      const tabKeys = Object.keys(state.db);
      const totalRows = tabKeys.reduce((sum, k) => sum + (state.db[k]?.length || 0), 0);
      document.getElementById('dbStatusBadge').textContent = `${tabKeys.length} abas • ${totalRows} registros ativos`;
      document.getElementById('dataSourceLabel').textContent = state.sourceName;
    }

    function renderSidebar() {
      const nav = document.getElementById('sidebarNav');
      const filterTerm = state.sidebarFilter.trim().toLowerCase();
      const allDbTabs = Object.keys(state.db);

      // Descobre abas extras que possam ter vindo de uma planilha customizada
      const knownTabs = new Set(CATEGORY_GROUPS.flatMap((g) => g.tabs));
      const extraTabs = allDbTabs.filter((t) => !knownTabs.has(t));

      const groupsToRender = [...CATEGORY_GROUPS];
      if (extraTabs.length > 0) {
        groupsToRender.push({
          name: 'Outras Abas Importadas',
          icon: '📂',
          tabs: extraTabs
        });
      }

      let html = '';

      groupsToRender.forEach((group) => {
        const validTabs = group.tabs.filter((tab) => {
          if (tab === '⭐ Favoritos') return true;
          return Array.isArray(state.db[tab]);
        }).filter((tab) => !filterTerm || tab.toLowerCase().includes(filterTerm));

        if (validTabs.length === 0) return;

        html += `
          <div>
            <div class="px-2 mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
              <span>${group.icon}</span>
              <span>${escapeHtml(group.name)}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="space-y-1">
              ${validTabs.map((tab) => {
                const isActive = !state.globalSearch && state.activeTab === tab;
                const count = tab === '⭐ Favoritos'
                  ? state.favorites.length
                  : (state.db[tab]?.length || 0);

                return `
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onclick="selectTab('${escapeHtml(tab)}')"
                    class="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-left text-xs sm:text-[13px] font-medium transition cursor-pointer ${
                      isActive
                        ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-sky-500/20 to-blue-600/10 text-sky-300 border border-sky-500/40 shadow-sm'
                        : 'text-slate-300 hover:bg-poke-hover/80 hover:text-white border border-transparent'
                    }">
                    <span class="truncate pr-2">${escapeHtml(tab)}</span>
                    <span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono rounded-md ${
                      isActive
                        ? 'bg-sky-400/20 text-sky-200'
                        : 'bg-poke-bg text-slate-400'
                    }">${count}</span>
                  </button>
                `;
              }).join('')}
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      });

      nav.innerHTML = html || `<p class="text-xs text-slate-500 text-center py-4">Nenhuma categoria encontrada.</p>`;
      renderMobileQuickPills(allDbTabs);
    }

    function renderMobileQuickPills(allDbTabs) {
      const container = document.getElementById('mobileQuickPills');
      const tabsList = ['⭐ Favoritos', ...allDbTabs];
      container.innerHTML = tabsList.map((tab) => {
        const isActive = !state.globalSearch && state.activeTab === tab;
        return `
          <button
            type="button"
            onclick="selectTab('${escapeHtml(tab)}')"
            class="shrink-0 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold border transition ${
              isActive
                ? 'bg-sky-500 text-slate-950 border-sky-400'
                : 'bg-poke-panel text-slate-300 border-poke-border hover:border-slate-500'
            }">
            ${escapeHtml(tab)}
          </button>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function selectTab(tabName) {
      state.activeTab = tabName;
      state.globalSearch = '';
      state.localSearch = '';
      state.filterCol = '__ALL__';
      state.filterVal = '__ALL__';
      state.sortCol = null;
      state.sortAsc = true;

      document.getElementById('globalSearchInput').value = '';
      document.getElementById('clearGlobalSearchBtn').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('localSearchInput').value = '';

      closeMobileDrawer();
      renderSidebar();
      populateLocalFilterDropdowns();
      renderResults();
    }

    /*************************************************************************
     * 6. FILTROS LOCAIS E ORDENAÇÃO
     *************************************************************************/
    function getActiveTabRowsWithMeta() {
      if (state.activeTab === '⭐ Favoritos') {
        const favRows = [];
        state.favorites.forEach((favId) => {
          const [tabName, idxStr] = favId.split('::');
          const idx = parseInt(idxStr, 10);
          const row = state.db[tabName]?.[idx];
          if (row) {
            favRows.push({
              tabName,
              rowIndex: idx,
              data: { Aba_Origem: tabName, ...row }
            });
          }
        });
        return favRows;
      }

      const rows = state.db[state.activeTab] || [];
      return rows.map((row, idx) => ({
        tabName: state.activeTab,
        rowIndex: idx,
        data: row
      }));
    }

    function populateLocalFilterDropdowns() {
      const colSelect = document.getElementById('columnSelect');
      const valSelect = document.getElementById('columnValueSelect');
      const rowsMeta = getActiveTabRowsWithMeta();

      const colSet = new Set();
      rowsMeta.forEach((item) => {
        Object.keys(item.data).forEach((k) => colSet.add(k));
      });
      const cols = Array.from(colSet);

      colSelect.innerHTML = `<option value="__ALL__">Filtrar por coluna (Todas)</option>` +
        cols.map((c) => `<option value="${escapeHtml(c)}">${escapeHtml(c.replace(/_/g, ' '))}</option>`).join('');

      colSelect.value = cols.includes(state.filterCol) ? state.filterCol : '__ALL__';
      state.filterCol = colSelect.value;

      updateColumnValuesDropdown();
    }

    function updateColumnValuesDropdown() {
      const valSelect = document.getElementById('columnValueSelect');
      const rowsMeta = getActiveTabRowsWithMeta();

      if (state.filterCol === '__ALL__') {
        valSelect.innerHTML = `<option value="__ALL__">Todos os valores</option>`;
        valSelect.disabled = true;
        valSelect.classList.add('opacity-50');
        state.filterVal = '__ALL__';
        return;
      }

      valSelect.disabled = false;
      valSelect.classList.remove('opacity-50');

      const uniqueVals = new Set();
      rowsMeta.forEach((item) => {
        const v = item.data[state.filterCol];
        if (v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v).trim() !== '') {
          uniqueVals.add(String(v).trim());
        }
      });

      const sortedVals = Array.from(uniqueVals).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, 'pt-BR'));
      valSelect.innerHTML = `<option value="__ALL__">Todos (${sortedVals.length})</option>` +
        sortedVals.map((v) => `<option value="${escapeHtml(v)}">${escapeHtml(v.length > 45 ? v.slice(0, 45) + '…' : v)}</option>`).join('');

      valSelect.value = sortedVals.includes(state.filterVal) ? state.filterVal : '__ALL__';
      state.filterVal = valSelect.value;
    }

    /*************************************************************************
     * 7. RENDERIZAÇÃO DE CARTÕES, TABELA E BUSCA GLOBAL
     *************************************************************************/

    function renderTrajesPriceHtml(price) {
      const p = String(price || '');
      const icon = (src, alt) => `<img class="trajes-price-icon" src="${src}" alt="${alt}">`;
      const text = `<span class="trajes-price-text">${escapeHtml(p || '—')}</span>`;
      if (/2\s*cupons? esportivos?\s*\+\s*1\s*pikachu fashion/i.test(p)) {
        return `<span class="trajes-price-content trajes-combo"><span class="trajes-combo-items">${icon(SPORTS_COUPON_ICON_1,'Cupom esportivo 1')}<b>+</b>${icon(SPORTS_COUPON_ICON_2,'Cupom esportivo 2')}<b>+</b>${icon(PIKACHU_FASHION_ICON,'Pikachu Fashion')}</span>${text}</span>`;
      }
      let src = null, alt = '';
      if (/cupom de troca de 200 campus à moda de lilie/i.test(p)) { src=LILIE_COUPON_ICON; alt='Cupom de troca de 200 campus à moda de Lilie'; }
      else if (/200 fragmentos do modo aliança pokémon/i.test(p)) { src=ALLIANCE_FRAGMENT_ICON; alt='Fragmentos do Modo Aliança Pokémon'; }
      else if (/200 fragmentos do modo foguete arco-íris/i.test(p)) { src=ROCKET_FRAGMENT_ICON; alt='Fragmentos do Modo Foguete Arco-íris'; }
      else if (/cupom de troca de luxo/i.test(p)) { src=LUXURY_COUPON_ICON; alt='Cupom de troca de luxo'; }
      else if (/ratos? de metal misterioso/i.test(p)) { src=MYSTERIOUS_METAL_RAT_ICON; alt='Ratos de metal misterioso'; }
      else if (/cupom de troca de fantasia/i.test(p)) { src=FANTASY_COUPON_ICON; alt='Cupom de troca de fantasia'; }
      else if (/diamantes?/i.test(p)) { src=DIAMOND_ICON; alt='Diamantes'; }
      return src ? `<span class="trajes-price-content">${icon(src,alt)}${text}</span>` : text;
    }

    function renderTrajesListHtml(items) {
      const header = `<div class="trajes-head"><div>TRAJE</div><div>FOTO</div><div>PREÇO</div><div>BÔNUS AZUL</div><div>BÔNUS ROXO</div></div>`;
      const body = items.map((item) => {
        const d = item.data || {};
        if (d.__Section === '1') return `<div class="trajes-section">${escapeHtml(d.Traje || d.Registro || '')}</div>`;
        const photo = d.Foto ? formatHighlightedValue(d.Foto) : '<span class="text-slate-500">—</span>';
        const fav = isFavorite(item.tabName, item.rowIndex);
        return `<article class="trajes-row" onclick="openDetailModal('${escapeHtml(item.tabName)}',${item.rowIndex})" title="Abrir detalhes do traje">
          <div class="trajes-name">${escapeHtml(d.Traje || '—')}</div>
          <div class="trajes-photo">${photo}</div>
          <div>${renderTrajesPriceHtml(d.Preço || '')}</div>
          <div>${formatHighlightedValue(d['Bônus Azul'] || '—')}</div>
          <div>${formatHighlightedValue(d['Bônus Roxo'] || '—')}</div>
        </article>`;
      }).join('');
      return `<div class="trajes-list">${header}${body}</div>`;
    }

    function renderResults() {
      const container = document.getElementById('resultsContainer');
      const localFiltersBar = document.getElementById('localFiltersBar');
      const globalTerm = state.globalSearch.trim().toLowerCase();

      // MODO BUSCA GLOBAL (Pesquisa em todas as abas ao mesmo tempo)
      if (globalTerm.length > 0) {
        localFiltersBar.classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('activeCategoryPill').textContent = 'Busca Global em Todo o Banco';
        document.getElementById('activeTabTitle').textContent = `Resultados para "${state.globalSearch}"`;

        const groupedResults = [];
        let totalMatches = 0;

        Object.entries(state.db).forEach(([tabName, rows]) => {
          const matches = [];
          rows.forEach((row, idx) => {
            const haystack = Object.values(row).join(' ').toLowerCase();
            if (haystack.includes(globalTerm)) {
              matches.push({ tabName, rowIndex: idx, data: row });
            }
          });
          if (matches.length > 0) {
            groupedResults.push({ tabName, matches });
            totalMatches += matches.length;
          }
        });

        document.getElementById('activeCountBadge').textContent = `${totalMatches} resultados em ${groupedResults.length} abas`;
        document.getElementById('activeTabSubtitle').textContent = 'Clique em qualquer cartão ou linha para ver detalhes completos e copiar.';

        if (totalMatches === 0) {
          container.innerHTML = `
            <div class="bg-poke-panel border border-poke-border rounded-2xl p-10 text-center">
              <p class="text-base font-bold text-slate-300">Nenhum registro encontrado para "${escapeHtml(state.globalSearch)}"</p>
              <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">Tente buscar por outro termo, nome de Pokémon, item, atributo ou data.</p>
            </div>
          `;
          return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = `
          <div class="space-y-6">
            ${groupedResults.map((group) => `
              <div class="bg-poke-panel/60 border border-poke-border rounded-2xl p-4">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-3 pb-2 border-b border-poke-border/70">
                  <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-sky-500/15 text-sky-300 border border-sky-500/30">
                      ${escapeHtml(group.tabName)}
                    </span>
                    <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">${group.matches.length} item(ns)</span>
                  </div>
                  <button type="button" onclick="selectTab('${escapeHtml(group.tabName)}')"
                    class="text-xs text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-300 font-semibold">
                    Abrir aba →
                  </button>
                </div>
                ${state.viewMode === 'cards'
                  ? renderCardsGridHtml(group.matches)
                  : renderTableHtml(group.matches)
                }
              </div>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        `;
        return;
      }

      // MODO ABA INDIVIDUAL
      localFiltersBar.classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('activeCategoryPill').textContent = getCategoryForTab(state.activeTab);
      document.getElementById('activeTabTitle').textContent = state.activeTab;
      document.getElementById('activeTabSubtitle').textContent = TAB_DESCRIPTIONS[state.activeTab] || 'Registros importados desta aba da planilha.';

      let items = getActiveTabRowsWithMeta();

      // Filtro por coluna específica
      if (state.filterCol !== '__ALL__' && state.filterVal !== '__ALL__') {
        items = items.filter((item) => String(item.data[state.filterCol] || '').trim() === state.filterVal);
      }

      // Filtro de busca local
      const localTerm = state.localSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (localTerm) {
        items = items.filter((item) => {
          if (state.filterCol !== '__ALL__') {
            return String(item.data[state.filterCol] || '').toLowerCase().includes(localTerm);
          }
          return Object.values(item.data).join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(localTerm);
        });
      }

      // Ordenação no modo tabela
      if (state.sortCol) {
        items = [...items].sort((a, b) => {
          const valA = String(a.data[state.sortCol] ?? '');
          const valB = String(b.data[state.sortCol] ?? '');
          const numA = parseFloat(valA.replace(/[^\d.-]/g, ''));
          const numB = parseFloat(valB.replace(/[^\d.-]/g, ''));
          if (!isNaN(numA) && !isNaN(numB)) {
            return state.sortAsc ? numA - numB : numB - numA;
          }
          return state.sortAsc
            ? valA.localeCompare(valB, 'pt-BR')
            : valB.localeCompare(valA, 'pt-BR');
        });
      }

      if (state.activeTab === 'Trajes') {
        const outfitCount = items.filter((item) => item.data.__Section !== '1').length;
        document.getElementById('activeCountBadge').textContent = `${outfitCount} traje${outfitCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} exibido${outfitCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
      } else {
        document.getElementById('activeCountBadge').textContent = `${items.length} registro${items.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
      }

      if (items.length === 0) {
        const emptyMsg = state.activeTab === '⭐ Favoritos'
          ? 'Você ainda não favoritou nenhum item. Clique na estrela (★) em qualquer cartão ou linha para salvar aqui!'
          : 'Nenhum registro corresponde aos filtros aplicados nesta aba.';
        container.innerHTML = `
          <div class="bg-poke-panel border border-poke-border rounded-2xl p-10 text-center">
            <p class="text-sm sm:text-base font-semibold text-slate-300">${emptyMsg}</p>
          </div>
        `;
        return;
      }

      if (state.activeTab === 'Trajes') {
        container.innerHTML = renderTrajesListHtml(items);
      } else {
        container.innerHTML = state.viewMode === 'cards'
          ? renderCardsGridHtml(items)
          : renderTableHtml(items);
      }
    }

    function renderCardsGridHtml(items) {
      return `
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-3.5">
          ${items.map((item) => {
            const entries = Object.entries(item.data);
            const [primaryKey, primaryVal] = entries[0] || ['Item', 'Registro'];
            const secondaryEntries = entries.slice(1);
            const fav = isFavorite(item.tabName, item.rowIndex);

            return `
              <article
                onclick="openDetailModal('${escapeHtml(item.tabName)}', ${item.rowIndex})"
                class="group bg-poke-card hover:bg-poke-hover/90 border border-poke-border hover:border-sky-400/60 rounded-2xl p-4 transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between shadow-md">
                <div>
                  <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 pb-2.5 border-b border-poke-border/70">
                    <div class="min-w-0">
                      <span class="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 block">
                        ${escapeHtml(primaryKey.replace(/_/g, ' '))}
                      </span>
                      <h3 class="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-white group-hover:text-sky-300 transition leading-snug mt-0.5 break-words">
                        ${escapeHtml(primaryVal || '—')}
                      </h3>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onclick="toggleFavorite('${escapeHtml(item.tabName)}', ${item.rowIndex}, event)"
                      title="${fav ? 'Remover dos favoritos' : 'Favoritar'}"
                      class="shrink-0 w-8 h-8 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center border transition ${
                        fav
                          ? 'bg-amber-500/20 border-amber-400/50 text-amber-400'
                          : 'bg-poke-bg/70 border-poke-border text-slate-500 hover:text-amber-400'
                      }">
                      ${fav ? '★' : '☆'}
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <dl class="mt-3 space-y-2 text-xs">
                    ${secondaryEntries.map(([k, v]) => `
                      <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-baseline sm:justify-between gap-0.5 sm:gap-2 bg-poke-bg/45 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg">
                        <dt class="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-400 shrink-0">${escapeHtml(k.replace(/_/g, ' '))}:</dt>
                        <dd class="text-slate-100 sm:text-right break-words">${formatHighlightedValue(v)}</dd>
                      </div>
                    `).join('')}
                  </dl>
                </div>

                <div class="mt-3 pt-2 border-t border-poke-border/40 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                  <span>${escapeHtml(item.tabName)}</span>
                  <span class="text-sky-400/80 group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition">Ver detalhes →</span>
                </div>
              </article>
            `;
          }).join('')}
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderTableHtml(items) {
      const colSet = new Set();
      items.forEach((item) => Object.keys(item.data).forEach((k) => colSet.add(k)));
      const cols = Array.from(colSet);

      return `
        <div class="bg-poke-panel border border-poke-border rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg">
          <div class="overflow-x-auto max-h-[70vh]">
            <table class="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs sm:text-sm">
              <thead class="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-slate-900 border-b border-poke-border text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">
                <tr>
                  <th class="py-3 px-3 w-10 text-center">★</th>
                  ${cols.map((col) => {
                    const isSorted = state.sortCol === col;
                    const arrow = isSorted ? (state.sortAsc ? ' ▲' : ' ▼') : '';
                    return `
                      <th
                        onclick="sortByColumn('${escapeHtml(col)}')"
                        class="py-3 px-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:text-sky-400 select-none whitespace-nowrap transition">
                        ${escapeHtml(col.replace(/_/g, ' '))}<span class="text-sky-400">${arrow}</span>
                      </th>
                    `;
                  }).join('')}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody class="divide-y divide-poke-border/60">
                ${items.map((item) => {
                  const fav = isFavorite(item.tabName, item.rowIndex);
                  return `
                    <tr
                      onclick="openDetailModal('${escapeHtml(item.tabName)}', ${item.rowIndex})"
                      class="hover:bg-poke-hover/80 transition cursor-pointer">
                      <td class="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onclick="toggleFavorite('${escapeHtml(item.tabName)}', ${item.rowIndex}, event)"
                          class="text-base leading-none ${fav ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-amber-400'}">
                          ${fav ? '★' : '☆'}
                        </button>
                      </td>
                      ${cols.map((col, idx) => `
                        <td class="py-2.5 px-3.5 ${idx === 0 ? 'font-semibold text-white' : 'text-slate-200'}">
                          ${formatHighlightedValue(item.data[col] ?? '')}
                        </td>
                      `).join('')}
                    </tr>
                  `;
                }).join('')}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function sortByColumn(col) {
      if (state.sortCol === col) {
        state.sortAsc = !state.sortAsc;
      } else {
        state.sortCol = col;
        state.sortAsc = true;
      }
      renderResults();
    }

    /*************************************************************************
     * 8. MODAL DE DETALHES & CÓPIA PARA ÁREA DE TRANSFERÊNCIA
     *************************************************************************/
    let currentDetailContext = null;

    function openDetailModal(tabName, rowIndex) {
      const record = state.db[tabName]?.[rowIndex];
      if (!record) return;

      currentDetailContext = { tabName, rowIndex, record };
      const entries = Object.entries(record);
      const firstVal = entries[0]?.[1] || 'Detalhes do Registro';

      document.getElementById('detailTabBadge').textContent = `${getCategoryForTab(tabName)} • ${tabName}`;
      document.getElementById('detailTitle').textContent = firstVal;

      const updateDetailFavBtn = () => {
        const fav = isFavorite(tabName, rowIndex);
        const btn = document.getElementById('detailFavBtn');
        btn.textContent = fav ? '★ Favoritado' : '☆ Favoritar';
        btn.className = fav
          ? 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-400/50 text-amber-300 transition'
          : 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-poke-card border border-poke-border text-slate-300 hover:text-amber-400 transition';
      };
      updateDetailFavBtn();

      document.getElementById('detailFavBtn').onclick = () => {
        toggleFavorite(tabName, rowIndex);
        updateDetailFavBtn();
      };

      document.getElementById('detailBody').innerHTML = entries.map(([k, v]) => `
        <div class="bg-poke-bg border border-poke-border/80 rounded-xl p-3">
          <div class="text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">${escapeHtml(k.replace(/_/g, ' '))}</div>
          <div class="text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-100 mt-1 break-words">${formatHighlightedValue(v)}</div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      const modal = document.getElementById('detailModal');
      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
      modal.classList.add('flex');
    }

    function closeDetailModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('detailModal');
      modal.classList.add('hidden');
      modal.classList.remove('flex');
    }

    function copyCurrentDetailToClipboard() {
      if (!currentDetailContext) return;
      const { tabName, record } = currentDetailContext;
      const lines = [`[PokéGuide DB — ${tabName}]`];
      Object.entries(record).forEach(([k, v]) => {
        lines.push(`${k.replace(/_/g, ' ')}: ${v}`);
      });
      const textToCopy = lines.join('\n');

      // Método compatível com iframes via execCommand('copy')
      const tempArea = document.createElement('textarea');
      tempArea.value = textToCopy;
      tempArea.style.position = 'fixed';
      tempArea.style.left = '-9999px';
      document.body.appendChild(tempArea);
      tempArea.select();
      try {
        document.execCommand('copy');
        showToast('Informações copiadas para a área de transferência!', 'emerald');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Não foi possível copiar automaticamente.', 'red');
      }
      document.body.removeChild(tempArea);
    }

    /*************************************************************************
     * 9. CONTROLES DE DRAWER MOBILE, MODAIS E EVENT LISTENERS
     *************************************************************************/
    function openMobileDrawer() {
      document.getElementById('sidebarDrawer').classList.remove('-translate-x-full');
      document.getElementById('mobileDrawerBackdrop').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeMobileDrawer() {
      document.getElementById('sidebarDrawer').classList.add('-translate-x-full');
      document.getElementById('mobileDrawerBackdrop').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function openImportModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('importModal');
      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
      modal.classList.add('flex');
    }

    function closeImportModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('importModal');
      modal.classList.add('hidden');
      modal.classList.remove('flex');
    }

    function setViewMode(mode) {
      state.viewMode = mode;
      const cardsBtn = document.getElementById('viewCardsBtn');
      const tableBtn = document.getElementById('viewTableBtn');

      if (mode === 'cards') {
        cardsBtn.className = 'flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition bg-sky-500 text-slate-950 shadow';
        tableBtn.className = 'flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition text-slate-400 hover:text-white';
      } else {
        tableBtn.className = 'flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition bg-sky-500 text-slate-950 shadow';
        cardsBtn.className = 'flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition text-slate-400 hover:text-white';
      }
      renderResults();
    }

    function renderAll() {
      updateHeaderStatus();
      renderSidebar();
      populateLocalFilterDropdowns();
      renderResults();
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      loadStateFromStorage();
      renderAll();

      // Busca Global
      const globalInput = document.getElementById('globalSearchInput');
      const clearGlobalBtn = document.getElementById('clearGlobalSearchBtn');

      globalInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        state.globalSearch = e.target.value;
        if (state.globalSearch.trim().length > 0) {
          clearGlobalBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          clearGlobalBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        renderSidebar();
        renderResults();
      });

      clearGlobalBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        state.globalSearch = '';
        globalInput.value = '';
        clearGlobalBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        renderSidebar();
        renderResults();
      });

      // Busca Local e Filtros por Coluna
      document.getElementById('localSearchInput').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        state.localSearch = e.target.value;
        renderResults();
      });

      document.getElementById('columnSelect').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        state.filterCol = e.target.value;
        state.filterVal = '__ALL__';
        updateColumnValuesDropdown();
        renderResults();
      });

      document.getElementById('columnValueSelect').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        state.filterVal = e.target.value;
        renderResults();
      });

      // Filtro de categorias na sidebar
      document.getElementById('sidebarTabFilter').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        state.sidebarFilter = e.target.value;
        renderSidebar();
      });

      // Alternar Cartões / Tabela
      document.getElementById('viewCardsBtn').addEventListener('click', () => setViewMode('cards'));
      document.getElementById('viewTableBtn').addEventListener('click', () => setViewMode('table'));

      // Menu Mobile
      document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn').addEventListener('click', openMobileDrawer);
      document.getElementById('closeMobileMenuBtn').addEventListener('click', closeMobileDrawer);
      document.getElementById('mobileDrawerBackdrop').addEventListener('click', closeMobileDrawer);

      // Modal Importação Excel + Drag & Drop
      document.getElementById('openImportModalBtn').addEventListener('click', openImportModal);
      document.getElementById('closeImportModalBtn').addEventListener('click', closeImportModal);
      document.getElementById('importModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target.id === 'importModal') closeImportModal();
      });

      const fileInput = document.getElementById('excelFileInput');
      fileInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
          handleFileUpload(e.target.files[0]);
          fileInput.value = '';
        }
      });

      const dropZone = document.getElementById('dropZone');
      ['dragenter', 'dragover'].forEach((evt) => {
        dropZone.addEventListener(evt, (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          dropZone.classList.add('border-sky-400', 'bg-sky-500/10');
        });
      });
      ['dragleave', 'drop'].forEach((evt) => {
        dropZone.addEventListener(evt, (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          dropZone.classList.remove('border-sky-400', 'bg-sky-500/10');
        });
      });
      dropZone.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        const files = e.dataTransfer?.files;
        if (files && files[0]) handleFileUpload(files[0]);
      });

      // Botão Restaurar Dados Padrão
      document.getElementById('resetDefaultBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        state.db = structuredClone(DEFAULT_DATABASE);
        state.sourceName = 'Online_traduzida.xlsx';
        state.activeTab = 'Tempo';
        state.globalSearch = '';
        state.localSearch = '';
        state.filterCol = '__ALL__';
        state.filterVal = '__ALL__';
        globalInput.value = '';
        clearGlobalBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('localSearchInput').value = '';
        saveDatabaseToStorage();
        renderAll();
        showToast('Dados padrão originais restaurados com sucesso!', 'sky');
      });

      // Modal Detalhes
      document.getElementById('closeDetailModalBtn').addEventListener('click', closeDetailModal);
      document.getElementById('detailModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target.id === 'detailModal') closeDetailModal();
      });
      document.getElementById('copyDetailBtn').addEventListener('click', copyCurrentDetailToClipboard);

      // Fechar modais com ESC
      document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          closeImportModal();
          closeDetailModal();
          closeMobileDrawer();
        }
      });
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
